name: 03431 · Keene, NH
findings: ZIP 03431 (Keene) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03431 (Keene) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
